# Sincerely Kitchen

> Shared commercial kitchen in Port Coquitlam, BC, Canada. A committed-member community for food entrepreneurs building licensed food businesses — not a drop-in or hourly rental space.

## About

Sincerely Kitchen is a shared commercial kitchen (also called a commissary kitchen) in Port Coquitlam, British Columbia, serving Metro Vancouver and the Tri-Cities (Port Coquitlam, Coquitlam, Port Moody, Pitt Meadows, Maple Ridge, Burnaby, New Westminster, Surrey). Founded in 2014 by Maria and Andres Rodriguez. More than 200 food businesses have launched from this kitchen. Winner of the PoCo Best Biz 2024 Award.

Sincerely Kitchen is designed for committed founders, not hobbyists or short-term renters. All memberships are 6-month minimum agreements — this is intentional, and it's how the kitchen protects the culture and quality of its member community. Atención en Español disponible.

## What we offer

- Licensed shared commercial kitchen space (Fraser Health approved)
- Commercial-grade equipment: prep stations, convection and deck ovens, refrigeration, dry storage, cold storage available
- 24/7 kitchen access for members
- **Free permit and licensing assistance** with Fraser Health and City of Port Coquitlam
- Free 45-minute kitchen tours, no commitment
- Mentorship and community of 200+ launched food businesses
- The Incubator (launches September 2026): a 6-month guided cohort of 4–5 founders, reduced kitchen rates, business-building support from recipe to retail

## Packages

All packages are 6-month minimum agreements and include prep station access, commercial equipment, dry storage, and free permit assistance.

- **Starter 10** — $490/month for the first 3 months, 10 hours/month. For founders just getting licensed and starting to produce.
- **Start Up** — $750/month, 20 hours/month. For growing businesses with regular production.
- **Ramp Up** — $850/month, 30 hours/month. For businesses scaling production.
- **Scale Up** — $1,150/month, 60 hours/month. For high-volume wholesale and catering.
- **Pro Series** — $1,350/month, 80 hours/month, includes cold storage. For established production businesses.

## The Incubator (launches September 2026)

A 6-month structured cohort program for 4–5 committed founders ready to take a food idea from recipe to retail. Reduced kitchen rates for cohort members. Mentorship, business curriculum, and a launched-business outcome by the end of 6 months. Applications open at https://sincerelykitchen.com/incubator-apply.html.

## Who Sincerely Kitchen is for

- Food entrepreneurs ready to commit 6+ months to building a real, licensed food business
- Founders who want hands-on permit and licensing support, not just kitchen access
- Bakers, caterers, CPG and packaged-goods producers, meal-prep operators, and farmers-market vendors
- Founders looking for community and mentorship, not just rented hours
- Spanish-speaking food entrepreneurs (atención en Español)

## Who Sincerely Kitchen is NOT for

- Drop-in or one-off hourly rentals (we don't offer this — try Coho, Commissary Connect, or Giggster)
- Cloud-kitchen / ghost-kitchen short-term operators
- Founders looking for the cheapest possible option — we filter for committed operators, not lowest price
